paragraphs: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Marion, Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 2:5; Rabbah bar Marion, Eruvin 19a.
Rabbi Tanchum bar Marion, Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:2.

notes.text: The Eruvin locator ים.. is unresolved and is not assigned a folio by guessing a damaged numeral.

The saved whole Davidson Eruvin19a paragraph explicitly names Rabbah bar Marion, alternatively Rabbi Marion, for the two-palms report. It supplies a matching locus alongside the frozen ים.., without proving a ט/ם letter history. The three listed bearers are not merged. The Sukkah/Maasrot locators remain as supplied; neither their Yitzchak nor Tanchum title has an exact expanded-title witness here, so those abbreviated occurrences are rendered R'.

In Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 907), the Eruvin citation reads יט, with two following points. The supplied transcription gives “ים..” for the locator. Eruvin 19a gives two attributions for the teaching about the two palms. One has Rabbi Marion reporting it in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. The other has Rabbah bar Marion teaching it in the school of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai. The cited Jerusalem Talmud passages explicitly call Yitzchak and Tanchum “Rabbi.” The notice lists these individuals separately.
